WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Search in natural language — no filters or boolean strings to learn
• Watch the AI plan and run each step of your search
• Get matches scored with clear reasoning for the fit
• Review each person's background and highlights at a glance
• Save people to your list and pick up right where you left off
• Unlock work contact details when you're ready to reach out

BUILT FOR
• Recruiters and hiring teams sourcing hard-to-find talent
• Founders and sales teams building targeted, high-quality lead lists
• Anyone who needs to find and evaluate people quickly

Sign in securely with Apple, Google, or email. Your searches and saved lists stay in sync with your Lessie account.

Lessie is free to get started. Higher search volumes, more contact unlocks, and CSV export are available with a Lessie plan.

Build a complete recruiting profile with stats, highlights, film, and academics. Get discovered by college coaches actively searching for your position, size, and grade year. FaceMeet gives each side of a hire its own AI agent.

YANIS, FOR PEOPLE LOOKING FOR WORK (FREE)
Talk to Yanis once, in a short voice conversation. He reads your résumé first, then asks about your work, where you can work, your right to work and when you can start.
- Roles that fit you, every day: remote or near you, with pay shown or estimated and the reasons each one fits
- A résumé and cover letter written for each role, from your own words. Nothing made up.
- Employers who come to you. When a company's role fits, Arianna asks to meet you, and your name stays private until you say yes.
- A text or email the moment an employer wants to meet you

ARIANNA, FOR HIRING MANAGERS AND RECRUITERS
Tell Arianna who you need in five minutes, or upload a job description. She builds a candidate profile and searches Yanis's network while you talk.
- An anonymous shortlist, each possible match scored against your must-haves, with the reasons
- See what the two agents said about each match
- Names and video unlock only when the candidate says yes
- Meet face-to-face on a FaceMeet video call, booked and held inside the app
- Searching is free. $50 when you ask to meet your first possible match for a role, and $950 when you hire a candidate through FaceMeet.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Nobody can browse your profile. Employers see an anonymous summary and only see your profile if you agree to meet them.

FaceMeet works on iPhone, iPad and the web at app.facemeet.ai.

record.description_evidence:
Get hired. Intervieux pairs realistic AI interviews and instant scored feedback with your own AI agent that works the job hunt alongside you, from finding the role to landing the interview.

Most people only get a few real interviews a year, so every one counts. Intervieux gives you unlimited reps. Have a natural, spoken conversation with an AI interviewer that asks real questions for your role, company, and industry, then breaks down exactly how you did and what to fix before the interview that matters.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set up your interview. Pick a role and industry, paste a job description, or upload your resume. Choose the length and the interviewer's style, from warm and encouraging to tough and challenging.
2. Talk it through. Speak naturally with your AI interviewer in real time, just like the real thing. No typing, no scripts.
3. Get scored feedback. In seconds you get scores for communication, technical knowledge, behavioral answers, cultural fit, and overall performance, plus the reasoning behind every score.
4. Improve and repeat. Read your full transcript, see your strengths and the areas to work on, ask follow-up questions about your results, and run it again.

MEET YOUR JOB SEARCH AGENT
A personal AI agent that works the job hunt with you, in chat.
- Finds roles on the job board and scores your fit from 0 to 10, with reasons
- Writes and revises real resumes and cover letters you can download, ATS safe
- Imports your LinkedIn profile so it knows your history
- Starts your applications and tracks where each one stands
- Connects your Gmail or Outlook and watches for employer replies
- Tells you the moment an invite, offer, or rejection lands
- Drafts your reply and sends it once you approve
- Sets up practice interviews for the exact job you are applying to
- Researches the company and role before you talk to them
It asks your approval before acting on your behalf, and nothing gets sent until you approve it.

WHAT YOU CAN PRACTICE
- General interviews for any role
- Interviews built from a specific job description
- Technical interviews with role-specific questions
- Comprehensive interviews that cover everything
- Resume-based interviews tailored to your experience
- Salary negotiation, for a new offer or a raise

WHY IT WORKS
- Realistic voice conversations, not flashcards
- A full transcript so you can review every answer
- Progress tracking across all your interviews

BOTH SIDES RUN AGENTS
Intervieux is where the hiring happens, not just where you practice. Browse the built-in job board, apply to open roles, and take role-specific technical challenges. Employers run their pipelines here too, and they have agents of their own that source, screen, and rank candidates all day.

That works in your favor. Publish a resume and it becomes searchable to employers hiring on Intervieux, read by their agents the same way yours reads their job posts. So when your agent surfaces a role for you, odds are an employer agent is surfacing you to them, for a closer look, an invite, or a direct message. Your interview scores feed that same signal. The better you do, the more often you come up.

WHO IT IS FOR
- New grads and students preparing for their first real interview
- Career changers stepping into a new field
- Experienced professionals chasing a bigger title or a higher offer
- Anyone who wants to stop dreading interviews and start winning them

Stop walking into interviews and hoping. Practice with Intervieux, get real feedback, and show up as the candidate they remember.

Intervieux Pro
- Weekly and monthly plans unlock unlimited AI interviews and full scored feedback.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
- Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.intervieux.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.intervieux.ai/privacy

Start free. Get U Hired streams fresh job openings the second they post, matched to your exact filters. Be first to apply, not the 300th.


AI POWERS YOUR JOB HUNT

Auto-apply bots blast generic slop at scale. Recruiters spot it in seconds, and your best openings die in the trash.

Get U Hired does the opposite. You send fewer applications, and every one hits hard.

• AI Job & Company Summary: the key facts on any role and company in seconds, no walls of text
• Job Fit Score: know exactly how well you match before you apply, with a full breakdown
• AI Cover Letter: a tailored draft in seconds. Make it yours and send with confidence
• AI CV Builder: turn your story into a recruiter-ready resume that flies through ATS


BUILD A RESUME THAT GETS READ

No blank page. No thousand cookie-cutter templates. Just one resume format that has worked for decades and sails through ATS filters: the Harvard standard.

• Start from your current resume, or from scratch if you don't have one yet
• Drop in the proof: projects, case studies, certificates, recommendations
• Talk it out. Type or speak your story as if to a career coach, and AI turns it into clean, quantified bullet points
• Refine with AI: see what's missing, what's weak, and how to make every line hit harder
• Tailor it to any job in one tap: AI builds a version sharpened for that exact role, ready to apply
• Export one polished resume, built to the Harvard standard, ready to send


WHY TIMING IS EVERYTHING

Half of job openings fill within 12 hours. By the time a job board shows you one, hundreds have already applied, and recruiters never read past the first 30.

Get U Hired pings you the moment a matching role goes live. Every one.


FILTERS THAT ACTUALLY WORK

Most job apps filter by role and location. Get U Hired goes deeper:
• Filter by salary
• Search on-site and remote separately. Office roles in your city, remote roles worldwide
• Include or exclude specific tech (you want Go, not Java)
• Filter by company size and industry
• Block companies you never want to see again


KNOW THE MARKET BEFORE YOU APPLY

The Market section reads hiring for your role off live postings.

• Tech Hiring Index: one number from 0 to 100 for whether hiring is heating up or cooling down, with a year of history
• Pay: 10th to 90th percentile from the postings, by seniority and by office, hybrid or remote
• New jobs posted: how many roles opened week by week
• Top hiring companies: who is posting the most roles in your market
• Most in-demand skills: what is rising in the postings, and what is fading
• What to learn for a raise: the pay premium each skill carries for your role

Invite friends to switch the market to another role, country or industry.


HACK YOUR SEARCH

• Apply on the company's official site. Skip the ATS filters and land in front of a human, not a bot
• Find the recruiter. One tap to the hiring manager, message them the second you apply
• Spot reposts. See if the same role ran in other cities or countries and find your best way in


TRACK EVERY APPLICATION

• Add any role in seconds: track one from your feed in a tap, or paste a job link and let AI pull in the company, salary, and details for you
• Build your own pipeline: rename the stages, add your own, and move every application from Applied to Interviewing to Offer to Hired
• See your whole search at a glance: a funnel, a Sankey flow, and an activity timeline, plus response rate and average reply time
• Keep notes on every job: interview prep, contacts, to-dos, all in one place


RUN YOUR SEARCH FROM YOUR AI ASSISTANT

On Pro or Pro Plus, connect Get U Hired to any AI assistant that supports MCP connectors.

• Ask for new matches with apply links and Job Fit Scores
• Have it move applications, change filters and write notes
• Pick which of six permissions to grant. Revoke access in Settings any time


Stop grinding. Start getting hired.
